claim: Oracle ended FY2026 (31 May 2026) with 141,000 employees versus 162,000 a year earlier, and reported $1.84bn of restructuring severance and related costs, per its annual filing (as reported by Tom's Hardware, 2026-06-22).
quote: According to the filing, the company ended the 2026 fiscal year with 141,000 employees, down from 162,000 at the same period last year.
title: Tom's Hardware: Oracle lays off 21,000 employees

claim: Oracle's annual filing said AI adoption has resulted and may continue to result in workforce reductions.
quote: The adoption and deployment of AI technologies across our operations have resulted, and may continue to result, in reductions to our workforce,
title: Tom's Hardware

claim: In a regulatory filing on a Friday in Sept 2026, Oracle said it expects an additional $700m of restructuring charges, taking the FY2026 restructuring plan to $2.8bn (prior accrual about $2.1bn).
quote: it expects to incur an additional $700 million in restructuring charges, bringing the total estimated price tag of its fiscal 2026 restructuring plan to $2.8 billion.
title: BusinessToday: Oracle adds $700 million to restructuring tally

claim: Oracle named Hilary Maxson (ex-Schneider Electric CFO) as CFO effective 6 April 2026; base salary $950,000 and target bonus $2.5m per an SEC filing (per TNW).
quote: Oracle has appointed Hilary Maxson , former executive vice president and group chief financial officer at Schneider Electric, as its new chief financial officer, effective 6 April 2026.
title: TNW: Oracle appoints Hilary Maxson as CFO

claim: Oracle began cutting up to 30,000 employees globally on 31 March 2026 per TNW; this conflicts with the 21,000 net decline in the 10-K, so treat 30,000 as a press estimate.
quote: Oracle began cutting up to 30,000 employees globally on 31 March 2026
title: TNW

quote: Oracle on Monday named Clay Magouyrk and Mike Sicilia as its new co-chief executives, replacing Safra Catz, who will shift into the role of executive vice chair of the board
title: The Register: Oracle tries co-CEO model again

title: The Register

title: DCD: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure revenue up 93%
